newsitem.title: CHINA: China pipeline firm 1996 profits at 206 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China pipeline firm 1996 profits at 206 mln yuan.

text.p: The China National Petroleum Corp's pipeline unit made 206 million yuan ($24.8 million) in profits in 1996, the Economic Information Daily said on Monday.
The newspaper did not give comparative figures and did not say whether the figure was before or after tax.

Sales of the China National Petroleum Pipeline Bureau, a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corp that conducts the parent company's pipeline operations, hit 2.804 billion yuan in 1996, the newspaper said.
Its pipelines handled 50.7 billion tonnes of oil and 114 million cubic metres of natural gas in 1996, it said.
The bureau built 1,724 km of new piplines and 410,000 cubic metres of oil storage tanks last year, it said without giving further details.
